articles.title: Mariana Salazar, 86, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Mariana Salazar for the many years of service to Kettle Hill.
body: Mariana Salazar died in January at home on Cooper Drive, at the age of 86.
Born in Kettle Hill in the years after the war, Mariana Salazar spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Kettle Hill. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Lower Millrace Improvement Group in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Playground Upgrade
body: To the editor: I have lived on Linden Terrace for 31 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Youth Center has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the playground upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Linden Terrace use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the March meeting.
Julia Corrigan, Mill Hill

body: To the editor: I have lived on Beacon Terrace for 40 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group has made.

articles.title: Upper Commons Asks Council for Speed Limit Change
articles.deck: The vote came after 39 residents spoke at Saturday’s session.
body: Residents of Upper Commons said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.

Councilmember Mildred Galloway asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $3,400. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

Public works estimates the work will take about 39 weeks once it starts in April. Residents of Upper Commons said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.
